description: This file defines the NotificationsHandler class and related interfaces for managing device notifications within an Android app. It handles retrieving notification snapshots, executing notification actions (open, dismiss, reply), and parsing request parameters.

classes.name: NotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing notification snapshots and executing actions.

classes.name: SystemNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: Implementation of NotificationsStateProvider interfacing with Android device notification listener service.

classes.name: NotificationsHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for handling notification-related requests and actions within the application.

methods.name: handleNotificationsList
methods.description: Fetches the current device notification snapshot and returns it as a JSON string wrapped in an InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleNotificationsActions
methods.description: Parses and processes notification actions such as open, dismiss, or reply based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: readSnapshotWithRebind
methods.description: Reads the notification snapshot and rebinds the service if necessary.

methods.name: snapshotPayloadJson
methods.description: Converts a DeviceNotificationSnapshot into a JSON string payload.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses the input JSON string into a JsonObject.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Extracts a string value from JSON parameters.
